title: Error-Type-Aware Loss Reweighting for Robust Named Entity Recognition with Noisy LLM Labels
abstract: arXiv:2608.30827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to annotate datasets for training smaller, task-specialized models such as named entity recognition. While this method yields effective models, it assumes that the synthetic dataset is correctly annotated. In this work, we find that (i) current fine-tuning processes simply ignore LLM-introduced annotation noise, resulting in degraded performance and (ii) existing noise-robust losses are not transferable to sequence labeling because annotation noise in named entity recognition is heterogeneous: for example, missing mentions and type errors affect the training signal in different ways. Treating all noisy tokens equally in noise-robust losses and applying a single reweighing criterion for all may therefore remove useful supervision or reinforce incorrect labels. translated_title: 面向含噪大语言模型标签的鲁棒命名实体识别：错误类型感知的损失重加权
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正越来越多地被用于标注数据集，以训练更小型的任务专用模型，例如命名实体识别模型。虽然这种方法能够训练出有效的模型，但其前提是假设合成数据集被正确标注。在这项工作中，我们发现：(i) 当前的微调过程只是简单地忽略大语言模型引入的标注噪声，导致性能下降；(ii) 现有的抗噪损失无法直接迁移到序列标注任务，因为命名实体识别中的标注噪声是异构的：例如，缺失的提及和类型错误会以不同的方式影响训练信号。因此，在抗噪损失中对所有噪声标记一视同仁，并对所有情况应用单一的重加权准则，可能会移除有用的监督信号或强化错误的标签。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了面向命名实体识别的错误类型感知损失重加权方法，该方法为不同的错误类型引入了各自独立的重加权规则……
tldr: 提出了错误类型感知的损失重加权方法，通过为命名实体识别中不同类型的标注噪声（如缺失提及和类型错误）设计各自独立的重加权规则，解决了现有抗噪损失对异构噪声一视同仁导致监督信号丢失或错误标签被强化的问题，从而提升基于含噪大语言模型标签训练的NER模型的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: We propose error-type-aware loss reweighting for NER, which introduces separate reweighting rules for different types of annotation noise (e.g., missing mentions vs. type errors), addressing the limitation of existing noise-robust losses that treat heterogeneous noise uniformly, and thereby improving robustness when training with noisy LLM labels.
